brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.requirement: Seven-cell honeycomb: one centre cell with six surrounding cells in a flower layout
requirements.evidence: Six full hex bases placed at level 0 around the centre base at (0,0,0): (1,0), (1,-1), (0,-1), (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,1). Seven full bases total.
Seven full top covers (cover:*;full;top), one over each base cell, including the centre.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps added (cap:* ;* at bearings 30/90/150/210/270/330) on the 18 exposed perimeter edges of the seven-cell cluster. The centre cell has no exposed edges and no caps. check_build: meshClash 'clear', no errors.

finish.summary: Built a seven-cell honeycomb work surface: seven full hex bases (one centre, six around it), a full top cover on every cell, and 18 caps on all exposed outside edges. check_build reports no errors and meshClash clear. One warning remains: the six outer bases are flagged as a loose body that could slide apart, because no joint bolts were added. The brief did not ask for joint bolts, so I left them out; adding them (12 internal joints) would lock the cluster together if needed.
